hints.title: Bitwise Conjunction Invariant
hints.text: For any two positive numbers a and b, a and b is always less than or equal to min(a, b). Therefore, the maximum possible bitwise and of any subarray equals the maximum element in nums.

hints.title: Contiguous Maximum Value Streak
hints.text: Any subarray having this maximum bitwise and value must consist solely of instances of the maximum element.

hints.title: Longest Streak Counter
hints.text: Find the maximum element max_val, then count the length of the longest contiguous segment of elements equal to max_val.

hints.title: Contiguous Max Streak Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass to identify maximum value and track consecutive occurrences.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all subarrays bitwise AND takes O(n^2) operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deduces that max bitwise AND cannot exceed the array maximum and finds longest consecutive run.
